label: Paul: seven-letter comparison
description: Comparison preset for the seven letters commonly treated as undisputed in Pauline scholarship. This grouping is not an adjudication of authorship.

label: Paul: additional six-letter comparison
description: Comparison preset for six additional letters bearing Paul's name whose authorship is debated. This grouping neither settles the debate nor assumes a single author for these letters.

label: Paul: thirteen-letter comparison
description: Comparison preset for all thirteen New Testament letters bearing Paul's name, in canonical order. Hebrews is excluded. Inclusion does not adjudicate authorship.
